data.name: Lindi
data.gender_notes: Lindi is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Old Norse word 'lindr', meaning 'flexible, soft, tender, clear, or water'. In ancient Germanic mythology, Lindiswas a goddess of the forest, rivers, and fertility. She was also known as 'Linda of the Linden Trees'. The name Lindi carries the meaning “Clear water” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Lindi usually hope their child will grow to embody clear water and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Lindi total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.
